name: Rachel Z.
quote: We had the best customer service with Jake Wade, at "Love is Blind"! Having come from a background in architecture, I could tell the product was absolute quality! I plan to use him again on further projects! Would recommend "Love is Blind" (Jake Wade) for anyone in DFW!

name: Dave H.
quote: We were beyond pleased with our experience with Durrell! We had gotten another quote from another company. Not only was Durrell less expensive, his customer service was way above!! Highly recommend this company. The shutters are beautiful!!

name: Katherine W.
quote: If you're looking for blinds, this is the company to use. Durrell was professional, prompt, and very helpful during the process and we LOVE our new roller shades! We received a quote from another company and it was almost double what we paid with Love is Blinds.

name: J. E.
quote: Jake and Jonathan were incredible throughout the entire Love is Blinds experience. They were professional and answered every question we had in a timely manner. Highly recommend working with them!

name: Mary Lynne A.
quote: My blinds are beautiful and I am so happy! Danny, the owner and installer, was so great helping me decide which products to purchase. He was professional, patient, and passionate. I highly recommend Love is Blinds in Tyler.

name: Chandler K.
quote: From start to finish Danny and his team members were great to work with! He made sure to understand our wants/needs in the beginning and was able to offer tons of options based on what we were looking for. He provides quality products and very professional and personable service. We are so glad we chose Love is Blinds over other companies!

name: Marcela C.
quote: Danny was professional, kind, and very helpful in helping me choose the blinds for my living room space. After placing the order, they arrived within the 3 week time frame and we were able to find a time to install around my work schedule. I really appreciate the attentiveness to detail and helpful tips for keeping my new blinds looking great! Highly recommend Danny and Love is Blinds!

name: Jerry A.
quote: Great experience with Durrell today! We ordered two plantation shutters for our home remodel a few weeks ago and today they were installed! Very professional installation and great customer experience.

name: Alexis A.
quote: We had Love Is Blinds come over. The blinds we had in our home were old and were pretty damaged. Jake came out and took care of us from start to finish. We love the cordless blinds and our rooms look so different! Great overall experience!
